title: Analista Júnior De Controles De Pld
description:
A área de Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Combate ao Financiamento do Terrorismo (PLD/FT) é responsável por proteger a integridade da instituição, por meio do monitoramento de operações financeiras e da identificação de padrões suspeitos. O objetivo central é assegurar o cumprimento das normas do Banco Central (Bacen) e do COAF, mitigando riscos de sanções e preservando a reputação do banco perante o mercado e os órgãos reguladores.

Desafios da posição:

Apoiar o monitoramento e a análise de transações financeiras, identificando indícios de lavagem de dinheiro ou financiamento ao terrorismo. O(a) analista atuará na execução operacional dos controles de PLD, no monitoramento de listas restritivas e na qualificação de alertas, além de apoiar análises de KYC, KYE, KYP e KYS, garantindo conformidade com diretrizes e prazos regulatórios vigentes.

  • Monitorar e analisar alertas gerados pelos sistemas de prevenção;
  • Apoiar os processos de KYC, KYE, KYP e KYS;
  • Realizar pesquisas em fontes públicas, listas restritivas internas e ferramentas de bureau, visando identificar PEPs (Pessoas Expostas Politicamente) e mídias negativas relevantes sob a ótica de PLD/FT;
  • Elaborar dossiês para suporte à comunicação de operações suspeitas ao COAF;
  • Apoiar a revisão e atualização cadastral de clientes;
  • Auxiliar na extração de dados para indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da área;
  • Contribuir paraa organização de evidências para auditorias internas e inspeções do Banco Central;
  • Acompanhar a fila diária de análises, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos regulatórios (SLA);
  • Apoiar a elaboração de materiais para comitês de PLD/FT e apresentações sob demanda.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Direito, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia (inclusive estágio) em PLD/FT, prevenção à fraude ou operações bancárias;
  • Desejável familiaridade com rotinas de análise de dados;
  • Pacote Office intermediário/avançado (ênfase em Excel — PROCV, tabelas dinâmicas — e PowerPoint para apresentações);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de busca e monitoramento (sistemas internos ou de mercado de PLD/FT);
  • Desejável conhecimento básico em ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex: Power BI) para acompanhamento de volumetria;
  • Conhecimento das normas Bacen 3.978 e 4.001 (e/ou regulamentações vigentes de PLD/FT);
  • Conhecimento dos pilares de PLD: KYC (cliente), KYP (parceiro), KYE (funcionário) e KYS (fornecedor);
  • Noções sobre produtos bancários (cartão de crédito, Pix, conta digital PF e PJ e antecipação de recebíveis);
  • Conhecimento sobre o papel do COAF e tipologias comuns de lavagem de dinheiro.

title: Senior Sales Specialist
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Sales Specialist to lead our sales efforts in expanding our market presence internationally. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing effective sales strategies, identifying key market opportunities, and collaborating with various departments to ensure alignment with overall business objectives. The position will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through the establishment and management of overseas sales channels and maintaining strong relationships with customers.


Responsibilities:

  1. Develop a deep understanding of the company's operating model and marketing strategy, and leverage this knowledge to formulate comprehensive quarterly and annual sales plans.
  2. Spearhead the establishment of an overseas sales platform, identifying and cultivating relationships with distributors and partners to expand market reach.
  3. Proactively engage with overseas customers to understand their needs, address inquiries, and provide appropriate solutions, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  4. Lead the preparation for and participation in international exhibitions and congresses to showcase our products and services, and network with potential clients and industry professionals.


Job Requirements:

  1. Bachelor's degree or above in international trade, marketing, or a related field. A background in a medical-related profession is advantageous.
  2. Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 3 years of proven success in international sales of surgical instruments. Experience in selling ultrasonic knives or surgical staplers is highly preferred.
  3. Proficiency in English is essential, as it will be used as the primary working language for international communications and negotiations.
  4. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for business trips, as required to support sales initiatives and attend industry events.

description:

Procuramos profissionais que vibram conosco e que partilham os nossos valores: paixão pelos clientes, respeito, imaginação, simplicidade e espírito empreendedor

Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação!

No Departamento Pessoal, garantir que “não deu problema” não é suficiente. Esta é uma disciplina de precisão, responsabilidade e impacto direto na segurança da empresa e na experiência das pessoas. Erros em DP não são apenas operacionais: podem gerar impactos legais, financeiros e de confiança.


Neste papel, você atuará na execução das rotinas de DP (ponto, benefícios, folha de pagamento, férias, medicina ocupacional, admissões, demissões e etc) com autonomia, garantindo qualidade, consistência e atenção aos detalhes, mesmo em situações que fogem do padrão.


No seu dia a dia, isso significa analisar cenários, tomar decisões dentro das diretrizes estabelecidas e garantir que os processos aconteçam com organização, clareza e responsabilidade.


Você também será responsável por se relacionar com vetlovers, lideranças e contabilidade, assegurando que as informações sejam corretas, bem comunicadas e confiáveis.


Espera-se uma atuação que vá além do básico: alguém que se aprofunde na execução, questione com critério e contribua para melhorias na prática, sem comprometer regras e limites definidos.



Quem somos

Nascemos em 2013 com um sonho: usar a tecnologia para simplificar a vida de pessoas que trabalham em pet shops, clínicas e hospitais veterinários. Criamos o sistema veterinário mais simples do mercado: intuitivo, fácil de usar e 100% online. Hoje, somos líderes de mercado, com mais de 8.500 clientes.


Para cumprir a nossa missão, contamos com um time incrível e apaixonado pela gestão pet. A prioridade de cada vetlover é oferecer uma experiência especial a veterinários, gestores e demais profissionais desse ramo.


E, na área de Gestão de Talentos, a nossa prioridade é garantir que os processos relacionados aos vetlovers aconteçam com qualidade, clareza e responsabilidade, contribuindo para uma experiência segura e consistente dentro da empresa.


Se você entrar na SimplesVet, fará parte da frente de Departamento Pessoal, dentro da área de Gestão de Talentos. Essa frente é responsável por garantir a execução dos processos relacionados à relação de trabalho, assegurando conformidade com a legislação, organização das rotinas e clareza nas informações.



Quais serão as suas principais responsabilidades

● Executar rotinas de Departamento Pessoal, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, legislação e padrões definidos

● Atuar diretamente nos processos de folha de pagamento, ponto, férias, admissão, demissão, medicina ocupacional, benefícios e demais rotinas relacionadas ao departamento pessoal, assegurando qualidade e consistência na execução

● Analisar e conferir informações e cálculos relacionados à folha, férias, rescisões e demais rotinas

● Atuar na interface com a contabilidade externa, acompanhando entregas, identificando inconsistências e sinalizando pontos de atenção

● Tomar decisões em cenários não previstos, respeitando regras, limites e diretrizes dos processos

● Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na execução e propor ajustes para validação do responsável pelo processo

● Apoiar a implementação de melhorias em processo, previamente aprovadas

● Apoiar tecnicamente outros vetlovers na execução das rotinas de DP

● Organizar suas atividades com autonomia, ajustando prioridades conforme demandas e prazos



Comportamentos esperados

● Organiza seu trabalho com clareza de prioridades, considerando impacto, prazos e diretrizes do processo

● Ajusta sua atuação diante de mudanças ou imprevistos, sem perder a qualidade e o controle das entregas

● Atua com responsabilidade sobre as informações, demonstrando cuidado e atenção a detalhes ao longo da execução

● Analisa situações do dia a dia com senso crítico, buscando entender antes de concluir ou agir

● Mantém consistência na forma de atuar, mesmo em cenários de maior volume ou pressão

● Comunica-se de forma clara e respeitosa, garantindo entendimento e considerando o impacto das informações para o outro

● Escuta diferentes pontos de vista e contribui para soluções de forma colaborativa

● Utiliza feedbacks e aprendizados da prática para ajustar sua forma de atuação



Requisitos obrigatórios

● Ensino superior completo

● Experiência consistente em Departamento Pessoal

● Vivência prática com:

  • folha de pagamento
  • ponto
  • admissão, férias e rescisão

● Conhecimento aplicado de legislação trabalhista

Diferenciais relevantes - necessário ter pelo menos um deles

● Experiência com medicina ocupacional (ASO, exames, SESMT)

● Vivência na interface com contabilidade externa

● Experiência com melhoria de processos (implementação prática)

● Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e melhoria contínua (Kanban, PDCA etc).



O que NÃO buscamos

● Perfil que apenas executa sem entender o processo

● Dependência constante da liderança para decisões operacionais

● Falta de atenção a detalhes ou inconsistências

● Postura reativa, limitada ao “mínimo necessário”

O que esperamos nos primeiros meses

● Domínio das rotinas de ponto, férias, benefícios e medicina ocupacional

● Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na execução, reduzindo necessidade de direcionamento constante

● Identificação de inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria na execução

● Participação ativa na implementação de melhorias já alinhadas

● Organização da própria rotina, garantindo previsibilidade e cumprimento de prazos



Remuneração e carga horária:

Saúde e Bem-Estar

Desenvolvimento Profissional e Humano

description:
About PSC Biotech



Who we are?



PSC Biotech is a leading Biotech Consultancy firm founded in 1996, headquartered in Pomona, California, USA, with Global operations in Ireland, India, Singapore, Australia and the US, serving 350 clients in more than 23 countries worldwide. We provide cloud-based software solutions for Quality Management and Regulatory Inspections, pharmaceuticals contract manufacturing professionals, and metrology services to our clients.



‘Take your Career to a new Level’



PSC Biotech disrupts the conventional consultancy model by aligning our EVP as one of the unique selling point which includes the opportunity to work with the most talented cohort of like-minded professionals operating in the Pharma/ Biotech Industry. We offer a permanent contract of employment giving exposure of working in Top Pharmaceutical client sites in a diverse-cultural work setting.



Employee Value Proposition



Employees are the “heartbeat” of PSC Biotech, we provide unparalleled empowering career development though Learning & Development in-house training mentorship through constant guidance to facilitate career progression. We believe in creating high performing teams that can exceed our client’s expectations with regards to quality of all scalable and business unit deliverables, staying under budget and ensuring timelines for our deliverables are being met.



KEY ACCOUNTIBILITIES:

Accountable to provide quality oversight to validation and equipment qualification activities to ensure these activities are compliant with all applicable regulations, company and contractual obligations.

Accountable for review and approval of commissioning and qualification activities, including the pre and post-execution review & approval of all validation lifecycle documents.

Accountable for providing guidance on creation of equipment lifecycle documentation, e.G. URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ, PQ protocols and reports, risk assessments, technical specifications, 21 CFR Part 11 assessment, Data Integrity Assessment, Configuration Specifications, Design specifications.

Participate or lead investigation, where possible related to discrepancies identified during qualification activities

Review & approve SOPs, Deviations/Event, CAPAs, Change Controls, Periodic Maintenance plans and user access request’s etc..

Effective interfaces with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication

Align with company’s Quality Goal and Strategy to set the Quality Goal, as well as monitor result and employee performance

Provide guidance to operation personnel regarding commissioning, qualification and validation. Work with the team on continuous improvement activities.

Comply with company requirements on EHS

Perform other tasks as assigned by QA department management.

Other responsibilities as required by QA management.


REQUIREMENTS:

· Minimum bachelor’s degree in biology, biotechnology, or relevant discipline

· Minimum 6 years of QA experience in the biotech/pharmaceutical industry, preferable in vaccine or biologics or commercial product experience, CDMO experience also preferred but not required.

· Mandatory experience in one of the following –

o Filling line qualification

o DeltaV and PI software

o HVAC and Utilities

At least 7 years of experience using KNEAT software

· Thorough working knowledge of regulations and industry best practice affecting product quality.

· Familiar with questions and challenges in audits and regulatory inspections.

· Experience of working effectively in a fast-paced environment

· Demonstrated problem solving and facilitation skills in day-to-day practices.

· Excellent written and oral communication skills, able to effectively interact cross-functionally and across all levels of the organization.

title: Tech Lead Frontend
description:
Sua carreira com liberdade e propósito

Na Remessa Online, não se trata apenas de transferências internacionais, criamos conexões que rompem fronteiras e transformam realidades. Somos movidos pela ousadia, respeito, colaboração, encantamento e responsabilidade.

Nosso segredo? Trabalhar juntos com transparência, comprometimento e autonomia, sempre buscando a melhor solução. Estamos revolucionando o cenário financeiro global, e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!


Como vai ser o seu dia a dia

Você vai atuar como líder de um dos principais times de frontend da Remessa Online , que é o time de B2C , responsável pelas nossas plataformas PF Web e Mobile .

Todo o time de engenharia participa ativamente das cerimônias ágeis e também das discussões de arquitetura das soluções . Aqui a gente respira regras de negócio e tem muita paixão pelo que faz. Usamos isso para construir, estruturar e evoluir nossos serviços cada vez mais.

Nos preocupamos bastante com a coerência e qualidade dos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais durante todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento. Para isso usamos práticas como Spikes e Slack Time , que ajudam a garantir qualidade, inovação e evolução contínua das entregas. Por isso, é importante ter resiliência e facilidade para lidar com mudanças de cenário .

Também valorizamos muito documentação técnica , melhorias constantes no codebase e estamos sempre abertos a novas ideias e soluções fora da caixa , até mesmo para problemas simples.

  • Gerenciar um time de desenvolvimento de software em um ambiente ágil, usando métricas de produtividade e com foco em resultados.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de carreira dos desenvolvedores do time, realizando 1:1 frequentes e feedbacks contínuos .
  • Liderar o planejamento dos projetos do time.
  • Acompanhar e garantir o progresso das tarefas e projetos do início ao fim , sem microgerenciamento.
  • Ser a principal referência técnica do time , conduzindo discussões técnicas e garantindo a aplicação das práticas de engenharia da Remessa Online (como testes, padrões de código e code review).
  • Desenvolver a liderança dentro dos squads, ajudando a fortalecer o engajamento e a retenção de talentos.
  • Criar e implementar processos, padrões e boas práticas de engenharia que ajudem a melhorar a eficiência do time.
  • Contribuir para a evolução da cultura de engenharia , promovendo um ambiente de inovação e colaboração.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outros Tech Leads e Staff Engineers , garantindo uma engenharia cada vez mais eficiente na organização.
  • Participar ativamente dos processos de recrutamento e seleção , ajudando a atrair novos talentos para o time.
  • Se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias, tendências e boas práticas , aplicando esses conhecimentos no dia a dia da equipe.


O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time

  • Conhecimento técnico em stacks de frontend (React.Js e Next.Js) e mobile (Flutter) , para orientar o time nas melhores práticas e ajudar a destravar impedimentos técnicos.
  • Base teórica sólida e preocupação com excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento .
  • Experiência trabalhando com metodologias ágeis .
  • Experiência em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software , desde planejamento até entrega, melhoria contínua e acompanhamento de impacto.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de soluções, observabilidade, monitoramento e escalabilidade de sistemas .
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de rollout gradual de serviços e aplicações .
  • Inglês para comunicação com providers internacionais .


O que oferecemos

  • Contrato CLT – Todos os direitos garantidos.
  • Bônus por metas – Recebimento de bônus atrelado ao cumprimento de objetivos organizacionais.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico – Cobertura para você e seus dependentes via SulAmérica.
  • VR e VA flexíveis – Créditos no Caju para usar como quiser.
  • Auxílio Home Office – Suporte para despesas e equipamentos.
  • Seguro de Vida – Proteção e segurança para você.
  • Auxílio Creche – Apoio para mães e pais.
  • Auxílio a dependentes com necessidades especiais – Apoio financeiro dedicado.
  • Licenças Estendidas – Maternidade e paternidade ampliadas para você aproveitar esse momento especial.
  • Descontos na Remessa Online – Para viver sem fronteiras!
  • Bem-estar e saúde – Consultas online com psicólogos e nutricionistas via Conexa Saúde e Psicologia Viva.
  • Wellhub – Acesso a academias e serviços como mindfulness, nutrição e terapia.
  • Apoio ao Empregado (EAP) – Suporte especializado sempre que precisar.
  • Day Off no Aniversário – Seu dia especial merece folga!
  • Ciclo de Desenvolvimento e Treinamentos – Desafios, capacitações e avaliação 360° para impulsionar sua carreira!



Atuação

Remoto : Trabalhe de onde quiser! Se preferir um escritório, temos espaço em São Paulo. Flexibilidade é o nosso lema.



Diversidade e Inclusão: Construindo o Futuro!

Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece e nos impulsiona a ir além. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas! Queremos um ambiente onde cada voz seja ouvida, cada experiência valorizada e cada contribuição faça a diferença.

Mais do que um compromisso, essa é a nossa realidade: um lugar acolhedor, respeitoso e representativo, onde juntos construímos um futuro mais justo, inclusivo e inspirador.



Descubra mais sobre a Remessa Online

Saiba mais sobre nós no nosso site e acompanhe nosso time no LinkedIn . Confira também o que nossos colaboradores dizem sobre a empresa no Glassdoor .



Vem ser #SouRemessa e fazer parte da equipe que transforma o mundo com ousadia, colaboração e responsabilidade!

title: Presales Engineer
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position:

We are looking for a Pre-Sales Engineer to join our global Revenue team! Based in São Paulo, Brazil , this individual will play a crucial role in showcasing the value of Optibus’ solutions to potential clients, including transportation providers and public transport authorities (PTAs) across LATAM. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to engage with prospective customers and help them navigate the challenges they face in optimizing public transportation. This is a hybrid role with a minimum of 3 days per week in the regional office/on-site with clients and will involve occasional travel (approximately 20%) within LATAM.

Responsibilities:

Client Engagement :

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to potential clients, building strong relationships with stakeholders and delivering tailored solutions to meet their transportation needs.
  • Conduct in-depth discovery sessions to understand client requirements and present how Optibus can address their business challenges with AI and optimization solutions.


Solution Demonstration & Education :

  • Become an expert in Optibus products and solutions, delivering impactful demonstrations, proofs of concept, workshops, and value assessments.
  • Help clients understand the full value of the platform, addressing technical queries and providing guidance throughout the evaluation process.


Collaboration & Strategy :

  • Work closely with Sales Executives to strategize and execute deals in rapid sales cycles, contributing to RFIs/RFPs and account strategy discussions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Product and Customer Success, to ensure smooth transition of client insights, facilitating successful implementation and customer satisfaction.


Market Leadership :

  • Develop deep expertise in the UK market and foster relationships with key industry stakeholders, including Public Transport Authorities (PTAs) and Public Transport Operators (PTOs).
  • Represent Optibus at industry events, webinars, and conferences to enhance brand visibility and demonstrate thought leadership in the public transport space.


Feedback & Continuous Improvement :

  • Collect client feedback to inform Product Management and Engineering teams, helping to shape product offerings and improve customer experience.
  • Support integration discussions and API implementations, ensuring smooth handovers to the Customer Success team for post-sale support.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience : Minimum of 3 years in a pre-sales, solution engineering, or consulting role, ideally within SaaS, public transport, or related industries.
  • Strong technical acumen : Ability to communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Project management skills : Experience managing multiple time-sensitive projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, start-up or scale-up environment.
  • Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, Portuguese and Spanish with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Collaboration : Demonstrated ability to work in a cross-functional team environment, collaborating closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams.
  • Please submit your CV in English for consideration!


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.


Interview process:

  • Initial screening with Talent Acquisition team
  • Team Lead Interview with Pre-Sales Team Lead (30 mins)
  • Manager Interview with Pre-Sales Manager (30 mins)
  • Case study interview with Pre-Sales Team Lead, Global Director of Pre-Sales and Pre-Sales Manager (60 mins)
  • HR call
  • References Check
  • Offer

title: Gerente Comercial B2b - Pesquisa
description:
Sobre nós

Com mais de 70 anos de existência, o Einstein Hospital Israelita, ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Além da atuação e setores assistenciais, temos oportunidades na área de Inovação, Tecnologia, Pesquisa, Ensino, entre outras. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!


Informações sobre a vaga

Local de Trabalho: CEP - Centro de Ensino e Pesquisa - Morumbi

Jornada de Trabalho: 220 Hrs/mês

Contrato: CLT Prazo indeterminado

Área de trabalho: Pesquisa

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido


Sumário

Responsável pela estruturação e gestão da Gerência Comercial B2B da diretoria de Pesquisa, com foco em resultados, sustentabilidade e crescimento do segmento com atenção absoluta às políticas de compliance. Atua de forma estratégica, liderando equipes multidisciplinares, integrando soluções para clientes organizacionais e promovendo relacionamento de longo prazo.


Responsabilidades

  • Construir em conjunto com as lideranças a estratégia da área com o objetivo de integrar as iniciativas da Diretoria de Pesquisa em soluções para o cliente externo, desenvolvendo o time e adequando a estrutura de acordo com as necessidades do mercado nacional e internacional;
  • Atuar na prospecção e gestão da carteira de clientes corporativos (hospitais, clínicas, farmacêuticas, laboratórios, entre outros) com o objetivo de criar bases para vendas e relacionamentos de médio-longo prazo, através de análises de dados de mercado e ferramentas de prospecção e segmentação;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentor na sua área, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento profissional dos integrantes da equipe e disseminando conhecimentos e informações para todas as áreas da Instituição;
  • Gerenciar negociações, propostas e contratos, garantindo o seguimento das políticas internas, através de monitoramento e gestão do time;
  • Responsável porgerir, acompanhar, monitorar e reportar os indicadores de performance e qualidade relacionados ao seu escopo, identificando oportunidades de melhoria, propondo e implementando soluções com base nas melhores práticas, contribuindo para o atingimento das metas estabelecidas para área;
  • Buscar o cumprimento de metas para garantir a sustentabilidade e crescimento do segmento, seguindo todas as estratégias de treinamento, segmentação e estudos de mercado;
  • Trazer novas estratégias de captação, fidelização e recompra para ampliar a receita, através de mapeamento das oportunidades de mercado e estudos das carteiras de clientes.
  • Atuar junto às diretorias de inovação e ensino em ações conjuntas, ampliando o impacto das iniciativas destas diretorias no que tange à pesquisa clínica e pré-clínica.


Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em áreas da Saúde, Administração, Comercial, Marketing, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em vendas B2B (preferencialmente no segmento de saúde);
  • Experiência em relacionamento com grandes contas;
  • Inglês e espanhol avançado
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas digitais: Power BI, MS Office (Excel e PowerPoint avançado);
  • Conhecimentos de softwares de acompanhamento de projetos.


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

Conforme política de contratação, o processo contempla as seguintes etapas:


  • Análise de currículo
  • Entrevista com RH e Gestor + Comitê
  • Entrevista final
  • Ressaltamos que todas as etapas são de caráter eliminatório.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Position :Business Development Manager – Brazil

Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Company : XTransfer- (Cross-border Payments)


About Us

XTransfer is a leading global B2B cross-border financial service platform, dedicated to helping small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) reduce the cost and complexity of global trade.

With over 800,000 enterprise clients worldwide and a monthly transaction volume exceeding USD 12 billion, XTransfer connects SMEs with top-tier financial institutions through a secure and compliant infrastructure.

As we expand into Brazil, we are building a strong local team to support Brazilian importers and exporters with efficient, compliant, and cost-effective cross-border payment solutions.


Role Overview:

We are looking for high-performing Sales / Business Development professionals to join our Brazil team. This role focuses on acquiring and managing SME clients engaged in international trade, especially importers and exporters.

The ideal candidate has strong industry experience in logistics, customs clearance, trading companies, or fintech, with an existing client network and deep understanding of cross-border transactions.


Key Responsibilities:

Identify and acquire new SME clients engaged in import/export activities

Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their payment and FX needs

Promote XTransfer’s cross-border payment and financial solutions

Drive transaction volume growth and achieve individual sales targets

Conduct offline visits, networking, and industry outreach (e.G., trade hubs, exhibitions, logistics clusters)

Collaborate with internal teams (compliance, operations, marketing) to ensure smooth onboarding and service delivery

Continuously collect market feedback and contribute to product localization and strategy

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following industries are highly preferred:

Freight forwarding / logistics companies

Customs brokers / import-export agents

Trading companies (especially China-Brazil trade)

Fintech / cross-border payment companies such as Remessa Online or EBANX

Foreign exchange or international banking services


Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree or above

Minimum 2–5 years of B2B sales or business development experience

Strong understanding of Brazil’s import/export ecosystem and payment flows

Existing client network in trade, logistics, or SME sectors is a strong plus

Highly motivated, results-driven, and comfortable with target-based performance

Strong communication and negotiation skills

Fluent in Portuguese, English, Chinese is a plus


What We Offer:

Competitive salary + performance-based commission；

Fast-growing international fintech platform with strong global backing；

Opportunity to build and lead a new market from an early stage；

Exposure to cross-border trade, finance, and global business networks；

Clear career growth path in Brazil and globally；


Why Join Us

Brazil is one of the most dynamic and challenging markets for cross-border trade. At XTransfer, you will be at the forefront of transforming how SMEs handle international payments—making them faster, safer, and more cost-efficient.

title: Contract Manager
description:

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or related fields;
  • Advanced/FluentEnglish (mandatory);
  • Solid experience in contract management (preferably in urban mobility, railway, or infrastructure sectors);
  • Proven experience managing subcontractors and suppliers;
  • Strong knowledge of contract risk management;
  • Experience withKPIs and performance metrics applied to contracts;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;

Nice to have

  • PMP (Project Management Professional) certification;
  • Experience withinternational contracts;
  • Knowledge of ERP systems (e.G., SAP);

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package;

On-site position (Monday to Friday) - 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM

title: Senior Business Development Manager - Brazil
description:
About Group-IB


Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Singapore, Group-IB is a leading creator of cybersecurity technologies to investigate, prevent, and fight digital crime. Combating cybercrime is in the company’s DNA, shaping its technological capabilities to defend businesses and citizens and support law enforcement operations.

Group-IB’s Digital Crime Resistance Centres (DCRCs) are located in the Middle East, Europe, Central Asia, and Asia-Pacific to help critically analyze and promptly mitigate regional and country-specific threats. These mission-critical units help Group-IB strengthen its contribution to global cybercrime prevention and continually expand its threat-hunting capabilities.

Each of us can help make the world a safer place.

Join us!


The role:


As a Senior Business Development Manager at Group-IB , you will be a key member of our LATAM Sales Team, driving sales strategies, meeting revenue targets and building clients’ relationships. You will lead sales teams, develop sales plans, and ensure customer satisfaction. This role involves prospecting, negotiating deals, and potentially managing a sales team, requiring strong leadership and communication skills.


This role is ideal for a motivated, self-starting sales professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a tangible impact in one of the world’s most dynamic markets


Tasks to solve:


  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Develops and implements sales strategies, manages sales pipelines, and monitors performance to achieve sales goals.
  • Team Leadership: Leads and motivates a sales team, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback.
  • Client Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strong client relationships, identifies new opportunities, and ensures customer satisfaction.
  • Prospecting and Sales Generation: Identifies and targets potential clients, generates leads, and manages the sales process.
  • Negotiation and Deal Closure: Negotiates contracts, closes deals, and ensures profitable sales.
  • Performance Analysis and Reporting: Analyses sales data, identifies trends, and provides performance reports to management.
  • Market Research and Analysis: Monitors market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify new opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works with marketing, product development, and other departments to align strategies and achieve business goals.
  • Admin: Deliver accurate sales forecasting and maintain up-to-date records in the CRM.
  • Trusted Partner: Position Group-IB as a trusted cybersecurity advisor through a consultative sales approach and a deep understanding of client challenges.


Qualifications


  • Experience: 10+ years of proven experience with sales, mainly in Cybersecurity.
  • Language: Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Role-based in São Paulo.
  • Leadership: Motivating, guiding, and developing a sales team.
  • Communication: Effectively conveying information, building rapport, and negotiating.
  • Strategic Thinking: Developing and implementing effective sales plans.
  • Relationship Building: Building and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Problem-Solving: Addressing challenges and finding solutions to improve sales performance.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with CRM software and other sales tools


Why GROUP-IB?


  • Your happiness is important to us: We want every single team member to be happy.
  • Continuing professional development: At Group-IB, you can choose from various paths to growth: progress as an expert, advance to a management position, try your hand in another department, relocate abroad, or launch a new business area.
  • Group-IB.A team with extensive international expertise: Do you have experience but are looking for exciting challenges? By choosing us, you will be choosing complex tasks and continuously improving your skills in a fast-growing international company.
  • Globally recognized technologies: Group-IB's members are located in 25 countries, and our products and services are sold in 60 countries. What’s more, Gartner, IDC, and Forrester have ranked our technologies among the best in their class. We work with over 450 international partners and about 500 clients.
  • A culture created by each of us: Group-IB’s employees speak many different languages and understand one another. We respect each other's beliefs, share common values, and strive toward the happiness of every employee.
  • Economic stability: Group-IB's sustainable growth helps rapidly develop careers that would take years to progress as far as most other companies.


What else should you know:


  • Flexible schedule: Group-IB does not have fixed working hours. You choose your schedule. We adhere to the principle advocated by Steve Jobs: “We have to work not 12 hours and head. ”Health: If anything goes wrong, don’t worry — we offer health insurance.
  • Certificates and training courses : Group-IB specialists hold over 1,000 professional certificates, including CEH, CISSP, OSCP, GIAC, MCFE, BSI, as well as some rare ones that would be a source of pride for experts in forensics, penetration testing, and reverse engineering worldwide. We have an incentive program that helps employees achieve certifications at the company's expense.
  • Challenges: A wide selection of GIB programs helps you improve soft skills, gain new competencies, and receive monetary rewards.
  • The initiative is rewarded: At Group-IB, you can bring your most daring ideas to life. The company encourages technical blogging, writing articles, building sports teams, and other creative activities.

title: Remote Kotlin / Java Backend Developer
description:
At Scanz, we are on a mission to bring magic back to trading software - specifically for active traders (aka day traders). To empower traders to do their best trading, we are building a next-generation Trader Analytics Platform that combines UI elegance with world-class real time performance. Founded in 2004, Scanz has become the platform of choice for 40,000+ traders to identify, plan and make their trades.


Scanz is a fully remote company. Today, our small but mighty team is distributed across North America, South America, Europe and Australia. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and our passion for software craftsmanship. We care deeply about the quality of our work.


As a very small team, we’re all generalists and constantly picking up new challenges. When it comes to code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick a problem and solve it. We use Kotlin, TypeScript and React to build a highly-scalable system so we can continuously make progress on a solid foundation. We don’t expect you to have a background in everything we use, but we do expect strong Java fundamentals (Kotlin even better) and a background working with React and TypeScript.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement server-side logic using Spring Webflux and Kotlin.
  • Build robust, reliable, fault-tolerant data pipelines that process millions of operations daily.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.
  • Develop and maintain APIs, ensuring high performance and responsiveness.
  • Contribute to database design and implementation (PostgreSQL).
  • Improve the system's throughput and incorporate performance testing into our CI pipelines.
  • Scale services horizontally.
  • Contribute to weekly standup.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin / Java.
  • Proficiency with Kotlin coroutines (flows).
  • Proficiency with Spring Webflux and Reactive Streams back pressure.
  • Self-motivated developer comfortable working as a core member on an A-list team of backend and frontend developers split over different time zones.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills within an asynchronous environment (Slack, Loom).
  • Deep-level understanding of distributed systems and how to make fault-tolerant applications.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Strong familiarity with database systems, particularly PostgreSQL.
  • Comfortable using AWS and cloud computing platforms.
  • Solid understanding of the testing pyramid, specifically unit, integration, and E2E tests.
  • Readiness and desire to participate in code reviews.
  • We're hiring across Americas and European time zones


Tech Stack

Back End

  • Kotlin
  • Spring Webflux
  • Ktor Server
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • RSocket
  • Ktor Client
  • Kotlinx Serialization
  • Quartz
  • Kotest + JUnit
  • Gradle


Front End

  • Kotlin Multiplatform
  • React (with hooks)
  • SharedWorker
  • TypeScript
  • NPM
  • Gradle


Infrastructure

  • AWS + S3
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Jenkins
  • Github

title: Content Operations Specialist
description:
Discover Peliplat

Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We’re evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact;
transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience .


With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films;
it’s where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time . From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we’re building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation.


On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema .


Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!


What Will Your Next Role Look Like?

As a Content Operations Specialist at Peliplat, you will play a central role in building and activating our interactive cinema community.

This is a hybrid role at the intersection of content, community, and live operations . You will create and curate content, activate users and creators, and operate Virtual Screening Rooms as high-impact social experiences.


From writing and editing to live event execution and viral content creation, you will help turn every user interaction into engagement, and every event into growth.;
by driving user participation, supporting creators, and helping scale our self-sustaining UGC ecosystem.

This role is ideal for someone who can be both creative and driven, and excited to operate in a fast-paced, startup environment.


Please include your portfolio, either integrated within your resume (as a single document) or provided as a link we can access. If your portfolio includes a password code, kindly specify it.


Responsibilities

Content Creation & Curation

  • Support content planning aligned with campaigns, screenings, and platform initiatives
  • Identify and amplify high-performing UGC and community content
  • Contribute to storytelling formats that drive engagement across the platform
  • Produce and curate high-quality content, including film reviews, editorial pieces, and short-form video content

Community & UGC Operations

  • Manage daily community activities, including discussions, circles, polls, and engagement initiatives.
  • Drive user participation across pre-watch, during-watch, and post-watch phases.
  • Foster a strong, positive, and interactive community culture.
  • Lead the execution of Monthly Writing Challenge operations and special event community challenges, including liaising with partner organizations under the supervision of the Manager of Public Relations.

Creator & Influencer Activation

  • Take ownership of creator growth by actively sourcing and recruiting new content creators, critics, and co-watching hosts across online platforms and in-person events, while onboarding and supporting their success on the platform.
  • Guide creators on how to host engaging sessions and grow their presence on the platform.
  • Identify high-potential users and nurture them into active contributors.
  • Support incentive mechanisms to drive consistent content creation.

Content & Growth

  • Capture key moments from screenings (reactions, discussions, highlights)
  • Edit and produce short-form video content for in-app and external platforms (TikTok, Instagram, etc.)
  • Collaborate with Marketing to create viral content loops that drive installs and awareness
  • Turn live events into scalable, shareable content

Data & Performance Optimization

  • Track key metrics such as engagement, event participation, content performance, and user activity
  • Analyze trends and provide insights to improve content, events, and community strategies
  • Continuously optimize workflows, formats, and creator activation strategies
  • Support operational tracking using tools like Excel or Google Sheets

Screening & Event Operations

  • Set up and execute Virtual Screening Rooms, including scheduling, video configuration, and live event management.
  • Act as the on-site operator during live events, ensuring a smooth, engaging, “cinema-like” experience
  • Support flagship events (e.G., creator-led watch-alongs) to generate high engagement and shareable moments.
  • Troubleshoot live issues and optimize user experience in real time.


Who You Are

  • Someone who can blend between content creator + community builder + operator.
  • Passionate about film, internet culture, and digital communities.
  • Highly execution-driven with strong attention to detail.
  • Creative, analytical, and action-oriented.
  • Comfortable working in live, fast-moving environments.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and resourceful.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Media, Film, or related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in content operations, community management, or content creation.
  • Strong writing and communication skills in English. Spanish, or Portuguese required.
  • Experience with UGC platforms, creator ecosystems, or social communities.
  • Hands-on experience with short-form video creation/editing (e.G., CapCut or similar tools).
  • Strong understanding of digital content trends and audience behaviour.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.


Bonus Points

  • Experience working with influencers or managing creator communities.
  • Background in film, media, or entertainment content.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and performance tracking.
  • Experience with live-streaming or event-based platforms.


Our Culture

As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in;
it’s how we execute.

We are building more than a platform;
we are shaping the home of movie buffs and redefining cinema as a shared, interactive experience . This requires a team that thinks beyond traditional models, moves with urgency, and creates value through both creativity and strategy.

Our culture is rooted in people who don’t just operate within systems, but who build, challenge, and scale them .

  • Ownership — Think Like a Builder
  • Strategic Hustle — Create Value Beyond Budget
  • Problem-Solving — Decode Complexity
  • Result Oriented — Drive Real Impact
  • Market Intelligence — Know the Game
  • Passion for Cinema & Community — Build What You Believe In

title: Customer Success Engineer
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position:

We are looking for a Customer Success Engineer to join our global Customer Success team! Based in São Paulo, Brazil , this person will play a key role as the central technical partner for our customers. From onboarding new clients, helping reach their initial desired value promptly, to ensuring they achieve continuous, measurable value from the Optibus platform at every stage of their journey.

Our CSEs are Optibus subject matter experts who bridge the gap between customer business goals and our technology. They guide our customers towards value realisation, including adoption of the platform, strategic technical enablement, solution design, integrations, running workshops, providing technical coaching, and collaborating cross-functionally across the business to drive long-term customer success. You will work closely with our wider team, including Support, PMO, in addition to Revenue (including Account Managers AMs and Pre-sales Engineers), Product, R&D, and other cross-functional departments.

This is a role with a strong client-facing component. You’ll be expected to spend at least three days per week working from a local Optibus office or on-site with customers.


Key Responsibilities:

Technical Enablement

  • Initial Implementation : Own the technical project delivery, managing data migration, initial platform configuration, and foundational user training to ensure a timely and effective go-live.
  • Continuous Enablement : Deliver staged technical enablement and coaching sessions based on the customer's maturity and specific business goals.


Value Focused

  • Value Realization : Plan and lead value-focused technical workshops, such as optimization scenario analysis, to demonstrate measurable value received and drive deeper platform adoption, as the technical partner supporting CSM/SCSE.


Configuration & Technical Requirements

  • Solution Design & Integrations : Work closely with clients and internal teams (Project Managers, R&D, Product, Solutions Architects) to define technical requirements and translate them into platform configurations.
  • Technical Expertise : Manage technical aspects of integrations with client systems and serve as the subject matter expert on platform capabilities.


Relationship Management

  • Relationship Building : Act as a trusted technical advisor, building strong, lasting relationships with technical users, stakeholders, and internal decision-makers.
  • Client Mapping : Maintain a deep understanding of the client’s organizational structures and technical landscape to ensure mutual technical goals are accomplished and risks are mitigated.


Customer Delivery

  • Project & Task Management : Working alongside the PMO/CSM, ensure all technical activities adhere to the project scope within budget, and are delivered efficiently and on time, from initial implementation through ongoing technical services.


Voice of the Customer

  • Technical ambassador : Represent the customer internally, collecting and analyzing feedback to inform the Product and R&D roadmap.
  • Escalation Management : Manage internal technical escalations with R&D, Product, and Support counterparts to ensure swift resolution of complex issues.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment : Collaborate with the wider Customer Success, Sales, and Product teams to align technical delivery with the overall customer success plan.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Adherence to Project SOWs and task completion estimates
  • Time to First Value (TTFV)
  • CSAT (Customer Satisfaction)
  • Utilisation
  • Time capture


Requirements:

  • Proven experience and measurable success in client-facing roles within SaaS (ideally vertical), with either B2B and/or B2G experience.
  • Proven track record of building strong relationships within a client portfolio with their technical and non-technical teams.
  • Exceptional ability to manage time-based projects, prioritize effectively, and drive technical outcomes across multiple client engagements simultaneously.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Proven experience of adaptability in fast-paced start up/scale up environments.
  • (Very) nice to have: experience in transit, public transportation, CAD/AVL, and/or ITS.
  • Please submit your CV in English for consideration!


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.


Interview process:

  • Initial screening with Talent Acquisition team
  • Manager Interview with Regional Head of Customer Success Engineering
  • Immediate Team fit with Senior Customer Success Engineer & Customer Success Engineer
  • Panel Interview with Regional Head of Customer Success Engineering, Senior Customer Success Engineer, 2x Customer Success Engineer(s)
  • HR call
  • Reference check
  • Offer

title: Analista De Planning
description:
Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas Comercial e Marketing Digital, oferecendo análises financeiras profundas, modelagem de cenários e construção de insights que suportem decisões críticas de crescimento, margem, investimentos em mídia, pricing, alocação de recursos e performance de negócio. O Analista será responsável por transformar dados em inteligência acionável, garantindo previsibilidade, rentabilidade e disciplina financeira nas iniciativas das áreas.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Planejamento e Performance Financeira Construir, atualizar e acompanhar forecast, budget e outlook das áreas Comercial e Marketing Digital. Desenvolver modelos financeiros robustos: CAC, payback, ROI, LTV, margem por categoria, impacto de pricing, elasticidade, e análises de mix. Monitorar KPIs críticos: vendas, margem, contribuição, media efficiency, CAC, GMV, ROI por campanha, share de tráfego, etc.

2. Business Partnering Ser o ponto focal financeiro das áreas, garantindo visão crítica, estratégica e orientada ao negócio. Traduzir performance em insights relevantes e recomendações práticas para suportar decisões de investimento, campanhas, promoções e sortimento. Participar de rituais semanais e mensais com lideranças Comercial/Marketing.

3. Modelagem de Dados e Automatização Construir dashboards, reports automatizados e modelos preditivos usando SQL, Python, Excel avançado, Looker/PowerBI (dependendo do stack). Criar estruturas que aumentem a precisão e velocidade do time (ex.: modelos de forecast por SKU/categoria, simuladores de campanhas).

4. Análises Ad Hoc e Inteligência Estratégica Desenvolver análises que revelem oportunidades ocultas de eficiência, receita e margem. Avaliar impacto financeiro de iniciativas estratégicas: novas categorias, campanhas digitais, frete grátis, mudanças de pricing, mídia incremental, etc. Acompanhar concorrência e tendências de mercado para calibrar benchmarks e expectativas.

Principais Desafios da Posição

Equilibrar velocidade com qualidade: Comercial e Marketing demandam respostas rápidas, mas com rigor financeiro. Criar previsibilidade em um ambiente dinâmico (promoções, sazonalidade, campanhas digitais mudando todo dia). Influenciar sem autoridade, garantindo que decisões sejam financeiramente saudáveis. Traduzir dados complexos em narrativas simples, consumíveis pela diretoria e pelos pares de negócio. Elevar a maturidade analítica das áreas, trazendo novas metodologias, frameworks e automações.

Ganhos para o profissional

Forte exposição executiva (áreas centrais + diretoria). Papel protagonista como parceiro do negócio. Desenvolvimento acelerado em modelagem, dados, negociação e storytelling financeiro. Participação direta em decisões estratégicas de crescimento da empresa.

title: Gerente De Transportes
description:

A Itatiaia é sinônimo de adaptação e diversificação. De móveis de aço a madeira, fogões, cooktops e eletroportáteis como airfryers e grills, a empresa lidera o mercado com cerca de 80% de participação no segmento de aço e é referência em cooktops e fogões. Com mais de 50 linhas de produtos, a Itatiaia oferece soluções completas para todos os clientes.


Presente em mais de 20.000 pontos de venda no Brasil e exportando para mais de 20 países, a Itatiaia garante qualidade, segurança e durabilidade em cada produto.


Transformando lares com a inovação e excelência que só a Itatiaia oferece!

title: Analista De Sucesso Do Cliente Júnior
description:
Analista de Sucesso do Cliente Júnior


Você é apaixonado por gerar valor e construir relacionamentos de longo prazo?


Estamos em busca de um(a) novo(a) Analista de Sucesso do Cliente Júnior (CS) para integrar nosso time!


Nossa missão é garantir que os clientes alcancem os resultados desejados com nossa tecnologia, promovendo engajamento e satisfação através de um acompanhamento proativo e consultivo.


Residir em: Vinhedo | Louveira | Valinhos | Jundiaí | Itatiba | Itupeva | Campinas


O Desafio:


  • Realizar o onboarding de novos clientes, guiando-os na configuração inicial e primeiros passos para garantir o time-to-value.
  • Monitorar indicadores de saúde do cliente (Health Score) e métricas de engajamento para identificar riscos de churn.
  • Executar planos de ação para reversão de contas em risco e recuperação de clientes inativos.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento e check-ins periódicos para validar a adoção das funcionalidades da plataforma.
  • Identificar e qualificar oportunidades de expansão de receita como Upsell e Cross-sell para o time comercial.
  • Atuar como a voz do cliente internamente, coletando feedbacks e sugestões de melhorias para repassar ao time de produto.
  • Manter o CRM e as ferramentas de CS atualizados com informações detalhadas sobre as interações e o status de cada conta.
  • Elaborar relatórios básicos de performance de contas para apresentação em reuniões de resultados..


Quem buscamos:


  • Desejável Ensino Superior completo ou em curso em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação Social, Gestão Comercial ou áreas de Tecnologia.
  • Experiência prévia em atendimento ao cliente, suporte técnico ou vendas, preferencialmente no modelo B2B SaaS (Software as a Service).


O que oferecemos:


Trabalho Híbrido em Vinhedo SP

Plano real de crescimento na empresa.

Início imediato.

Tipo de vaga: Efetivo CLT

Auxílio Combustível R$ 300,00 (trezentos reais) por mês | VA (iFood Benefícios) R$ 230,72 (Duzentos e trinta reais e setenta e dois centavos) por mês | Gympass | SESC SP | Espaço de Convivência.

SaaS (Obrigatório)

title: Manufacturing Support Engineers - MES Syncade
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Manufacturing Support Engineers - MES Syncade who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Proficiency in Manufacturing Engineering MES, with a strong background in Syncade MES.
  • Deep understanding of the Life Sciences domain, specifically in regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and validated system environments.
  • Experience working within Agile frameworks and sprint-based development processes.
  • Solid knowledge of database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle).
  • Hands-on experience in application architecture, design patterns, and development practices.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering MES, specifically in life sciences or pharmaceutical industries, is required.
  • Candidates must have completed 15 years of full-time education.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform independently and progressively grow into a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for MES applications.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for shop-floor users; diagnose, resolve, and document issues for Syncade.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Quality, and IT to restore service quickly and minimize production impact
  • Propose and deliver practical solutions to business and technical problems.
  • Maintain and improve support knowledge (KB articles, SOPs) and provide targeted user coaching and quick tips to reduce repeat issues.
  • Monitor system health and alerts; identify patterns and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) or continuous improvement suggestions. Conduct and participate in peer code reviews; provide constructive feedback to uphold development standards.
  • Remain current on application development trends, MES technologies, and industry best practices.

title: Ivanti ITSM Support
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform.
  • Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution.
  • User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog.
  • Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed.
  • Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
  • Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations.


Technical Requirements (Must-haves)

  • Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM .
  • ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management).
  • Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Full-stack pleno Laravel, PHP, Vue.js
description:
Requisitos da vaga

  • 6 a 10 anos de experiência como desenvolvedor;
  • 4 anos de experiência profissional com Laravel + PHP;
  • 2 anos com experiência profissional Vue.js;
  • Experiência com Bootstrap;
  • Experiência na construção, manutenção e documentação de APIs;
  • Experiência com MySQL;
  • Experiência com controle de versões;


Desejável (não eliminatório, mas um plus)

  • Experiência Docker;

title: Engenheiro DevOps (inglês fluente)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:


• Instalar, configurar, administrar e dar suporte a sistemas e serviços de Core Banking em diferentes ambientes (DEV/UAT/PROD).

• Automatizar atividades operacionais e de deploy utilizando Rundeck e Ansible (orquestração de jobs, playbooks/roles, inventários e gerenciamento seguro de credenciais).

• Criar e manter runbooks, procedimentos operacionais e documentação padrão para permitir execuções repetíveis e auditáveis.

• Fornecer suporte à produção e participar da resposta a incidentes, incluindo triagem, correção e análises pós-incidente (RCA/gestão de problemas).

• Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas; implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

• Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

• Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.


Requisitos:

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus)
description:
Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus) | Remote


QAT Global, a QAT Global US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Senior Magento Developer in Brazil to join an international project supporting a US client.

This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to performance improvements, technical analysis, and long-term platform stability in a complex Magento environment.


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Hiring Model: CLT only


Main Challenges:


  • Analyze and improve performance across the Magento platform, identifying backend, database, and front-end bottlenecks
  • Review legacy customizations and refactor technical debt impacting platform efficiency
  • Optimize JavaScript execution and storefront rendering performance
  • Evaluate modules, extensions, and integrations according to Magento best practices
  • Support code deployment and version control using GitHub and CI/CD workflows
  • Investigate root causes of production issues and propose scalable technical solutions
  • Contribute with architectural recommendations focused on scalability, maintainability, and security


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience with Magento development (Magento 2 strongly preferred)
  • Strong expertise in Magento architecture, module development, and customizations
  • Proven experience troubleshooting performance issues and legacy code problems
  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript performance optimization in Magento storefronts
  • Strong experience with PHP, HTML5, CSS, and codebase improvement
  • Experience with repository management and deployment workflows using GitHub
  • Ability to work directly with technical teams and client stakeholders in English


Preferred Background:


  • Magento caching and database optimization
  • CI/CD and DevOps practices
  • Code audits and technical health assessments
  • Large-scale e-commerce environments


This role is particularly relevant for professionals who have already worked with complex Magento environments, production troubleshooting, and technical modernization of existing platforms.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.
